name: AudioPlayer
title: AudioPlayer
summary: The audio Bible player: a full player with cover, seek bar, speed and transport controls, and a docked mini player in light and dark.
whenToUse: Use the full player `.sx-player` on a listen page or when the reader taps Listen in ReadingView.
Use the mini player `.sx-mini` docked at the bottom of the screen while audio keeps playing as the reader moves around.
whenNotToUse: Do not use for ISM Radio live streams; use StationCard and its live player.
Do not use for video; use VideoPlayer.

anatomy.description: Full player: square cover (240px) beside the title, seek track, times and controls. Mini player:

props.name: variant
props.description: `full`: cover, seek bar and transport. `mini`: docked light bar. `miniDark`: docked dark bar.

props.name: playing
props.description: Whether audio is playing. Drives the play/pause icon and label.

props.name: loading
props.description: Show the loading spinner in the play button.

props.name: position
props.description: Current position in seconds.

props.name: duration
props.description: Total duration in seconds.

props.name: speed
props.description: Playback speed multiplier.

props.name: speeds
props.description: Speeds the speed button cycles through.

props.name: skipSeconds
props.description: Seconds the skip buttons jump.

props.name: seekStep
props.description: Seconds one arrow key moves the seek slider.

props.name: title
props.description: Title, for example "John 3 · Amharic".

props.name: subtitle
props.description: Full variant subtitle: native name then "Narrated Bible".

props.name: subtitleLang
props.description: Language of the subtitle's native-script text (BCP 47), for example "am". Set on the subtitle paragraph.

props.name: nowPlaying
props.description: Overline of the full variant, for example "Now playing · dot.Bible Audio".

props.name: coverSrc
props.description: Cover image URL (decorative).

props.name: meta
props.description: Mini player meta line. Defaults to "2:14 / 5:52" built from `position` and `duration`.

props.name: pausedLabel
props.description: Text shown before the default meta while paused, for example "Paused". Omit for none.

props.name: onPlayPause
props.description: Called when the play/pause button is pressed. Never autoplay.

props.name: onSeek
props.description: Called with the new position in seconds when the reader seeks (keyboard or pointer) or skips.

props.name: onSpeedChange
props.description: Called with the next speed when the speed button is pressed. The button is shown only when given.

props.name: onPrevious
props.description: Previous chapter. The button is shown only when given.

props.name: onNext
props.description: Next chapter. The button is shown only when given.

props.name: onChapterList
props.description: Chapter list. The button is shown only when given.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Closes the mini player; shown in place of the skip button while paused.

props.name: labels
props.description: Accessible names.

props.name: formatTime
props.description: Format a number of seconds for display.

props.name: title
props.description: Title, "Book chapter · Language", e.g. "John 3 · Amharic".

props.name: subtitle
props.description: Native-name subtitle, e.g. "ዮሐንስ 3 · Narrated Bible".

props.name: subtitleLang
props.description: Language of the subtitle (sets `lang` behaviour: script line-height and direction), e.g. "am".

props.name: overline
props.description: Small caption above the title.

props.name: speed
props.description: Current speed multiplier.

props.name: onSpeedChange
props.description: Called with the next speed in the cycle 1x, 1.25x, 1.5x, 0.75x.

props.name: onSeek
props.description: Called while dragging or adjusting the seek bar, with seconds.

props.name: onPrevious
props.description: Previous chapter. Hides the button when omitted.

props.name: onNext
props.description: Next chapter. Hides the button when omitted.

props.name: onOpenChapters
props.description: Opens the chapter list. Hides the button when omitted.

props.name: formatValueText
props.description: Spoken form of a position for the slider. Defaults to English "2 minutes 14 seconds".

variants.classes: .sx-player (stacks under 768px, cover goes full width square)
.sx-mini sx-mini-dark (--charcoal-900; play button turns white with black icon; progress --blue-on-dark)

variantNotes: Play button `.sx-big` (68px; `.sx-big-md` 52px, `.sx-big-sm` 44px): playing (pause icon), paused (play icon), hover (`--horizon-blue-dim`), loading (`.spin` inside, `role="img" aria-label="Loading"`). Speed `.sx-speed` cycles 1x → 1.25x → 1.5x → 0.75x. Paused mini player swaps the skip button for "Close player".

states.universal: See rules/states.md for the seven required states and their hooks.

rules: One Horizon Blue control: the play/pause button. Everything else is quiet (`.sx-ctrl` transparent, `.sx-ibtn` outlined).
Seek track is 6px, fill `--horizon-blue`, 18px white knob with a blue ring.
Show elapsed on the left and remaining (with −) on the right, in tabular numbers.
Skip buttons jump 15 seconds and show "15" inside the icon.
Transport buttons are 48px; mini player controls are 44px. Never smaller.
The chapter list button drills into a list, so it uses the list icon, not a caret.
do: Use the full player `.sx-player` on a listen page or when the reader taps Listen in ReadingView.
Use the mini player `.sx-mini` docked at the bottom of the screen while audio keeps playing as the reader moves around.
One Horizon Blue control: the play/pause button. Everything else is quiet (`.sx-ctrl` transparent, `.sx-ibtn` outlined).
Seek track is 6px, fill `--horizon-blue`, 18px white knob with a blue ring.
Show elapsed on the left and remaining (with −) on the right, in tabular numbers.
Skip buttons jump 15 seconds and show "15" inside the icon.
Transport buttons are 48px; mini player controls are 44px. Never smaller.
The chapter list button drills into a list, so it uses the list icon, not a caret.
dont: Do not use for ISM Radio live streams; use StationCard and its live player.
Do not use for video; use VideoPlayer.
accessibility: The seek track is a focusable `role="slider"` with min, max, now and a spoken `aria-valuetext` ("2 minutes 14 seconds"); arrow keys move 5 seconds.
Swap the play button's `aria-label` between "Play" and "Pause" with its icon.
The speed button's label includes the value ("Playback speed, 1.25x").
Cover images are decorative (`alt=""`); the title carries the meaning.
